description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkPromptBuilder in the OpenClawKit project, verifying the behavior of prompt construction based on different input parameters.

classes.name: TalkPromptBuilderTests
classes.description: A test case class for testing the TalkPromptBuilder's prompt creation methods.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesTranscript
methods.description: Tests that the built prompt includes the input transcript and a fixed phrase indicating talk mode activation.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesInterruptionLineWhenProvided
methods.description: Validates that the prompt contains an interruption timestamp when provided.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesVoiceDirectiveHintByDefault
methods.description: Checks that the default prompt includes the voice directive hint.

methods.name: testBuildExcludesVoiceDirectiveHintWhenDisabled
methods.description: Ensures that the voice directive hint is omitted when explicitly disabled.
